{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOBGLqvc8AAAABVYW6MQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlvlNzg-5rCs", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlvlN", "number": 19, "title": "Prepare mmd-parser 1.1.2 for manual npm publish", "body": "## Problem

The PMX additional UV morph parsing fix from Issue #17 has been merged to `master`, but the package version is still `1.1.1`.

Because npm package versions are immutable, the merged parser fix needs a new release version before it can be consumed from npm.

## Expected outcome

Prepare `mmd-parser@1.1.2` completely for release so that, after this Issue is merged, the maintainer only needs to authenticate with npm if necessary and run the documented `npm publish` command on the validated release tarball.

The implementation must not publish to npm, create/push `v1.1.2`, or require npm credentials.

## Scope

- Bump the package version from `1.1.1` to `1.1.2`.
- Update version-specific package validation and release documentation for `1.1.2`.
- Regenerate and include any tracked build artifacts required by the package.
- Ensure the `1.1.2` artifact contains the PMX additional UV morph parsing fix merged through Issue #17 / PR #18.
- Prepare and validate the exact tarball that the maintainer will publish.
- Keep parser behavior unchanged except for changes already merged to `master`.
- Do not publish the package or create/push the release tag as part of this Issue.

## Reproduction (when relevant)

Current `master` contains the additional UV morph parsing fix, while `package.json` remains at `1.1.1`.

The already published `mmd-parser@1.1.1` cannot be modified, so the next release must be `1.1.2`.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Set `package.json` version to `1.1.2`.
- [ ] Update `scripts/test-package.js` and any other version-specific package checks to expect `mmd-parser@1.1.2`.
- [ ] Update `Readme.md`, `docs/releases.md`, and release evidence/documentation to refer to `1.1.2`.
- [ ] Run the complete release validation successfully:
  - `npm run build-uglify`
  - `npm run typecheck`
  - `npm run test:offline`
  - `npm test`
  - `npm run test:package`
  - `git diff --check`
- [ ] Confirm the additional UV morph regression coverage for types 4–7 is included and passing in the release build.
- [ ] Create `mmd-parser-1.1.2.tgz` outside the repository with `npm pack`.
- [ ] Validate that exact tarball with `npm run test:package -- <tarball>`.
- [ ] Confirm the tarball contains the expected runtime bundles, native ESM build, declarations, package metadata, README, and license, and no unintended source/test/repository/authentication files.
- [ ] Confirm isolated CommonJS, native Node ESM, and strict TypeScript consumers pass using the validated tarball.
- [ ] Record the tarball path, SHA-256, npm integrity/shasum, package contents, source commit, and successful checks in release evidence.
- [ ] Document the exact maintainer publish command using the validated tarball:
  `npm publish <path-to-mmd-parser-1.1.2.tgz> --access public --tag latest --userconfig "$HOME/.npmrc" --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org`
- [ ] Do not require npm login, publication, registry verification, or Git tag creation for PR approval or Issue completion.
- [ ] Do not add npm credentials, tokens, OTPs, or a project-local authenticated `.npmrc` to the repository.

## Required post-merge verification

None for Issue completion.

The maintainer will perform release publication manually after merge. The release guide should document the separate follow-up steps for:

1. npm authentication if needed,
2. verifying that `mmd-parser@1.1.2` does not already exist,
3. publishing the validated `1.1.2` tarball,
4. verifying the registry artifact and `latest` dist-tag,
5. creating/pushing `v1.1.2` only after publication and registry verification succeed.

These maintainer-only release actions must not block pre-merge approval or Issue completion.
